load_pattern.special: Double-wrap all pallets. No product overhang beyond pallet edge.

sop_rules.receiving: Verify all lot numbers. Reject if temp >5°F above threshold.
sop_rules.shipping: All pallets must be stretch-wrapped minimum 3 revolutions.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Any punctured packaging on food items = full pallet reject.
sop_rules.temp_check: Probe minimum 3 cases per pallet for frozen/refrigerated.

load_pattern.special: Club-pack orientation: barcode facing scanner side. Tier sheets between layers.

sop_rules.receiving: Count every case. No tolerance on Bulkhaven brand items.
sop_rules.shipping: Pallets must not exceed 60 inches height including pallet.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject entire lot if any case shows temperature abuse signs.
sop_rules.temp_check: Digital probe required. Handwritten readings not accepted.

load_pattern.special: Stack by department: dairy together, frozen together. No mixing categories on same pallet.

sop_rules.receiving: Verify expiry dates are minimum 14 days out.
sop_rules.shipping: Segregate organic from conventional on separate pallets.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject if >5% of cases damaged. Partial accept if ≤5%.
sop_rules.temp_check: Probe center cases, not edge cases.

load_pattern.special: All pallets must have Beacon Goods pallet tags. No handwritten labels.

sop_rules.receiving: Scan every case barcode. Manual entry not permitted.
sop_rules.shipping: GTIN verification required on every SKU before loading.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject if product not in Beacon Goods' approved vendor list.
sop_rules.temp_check: Infrared and probe readings both required for frozen.

load_pattern.special: Display-ready pallets must not be re-stacked. Ship as received from vendor.

sop_rules.receiving: Match ASN (Advance Ship Notice) to physical count.
sop_rules.shipping: Pallet weight must not exceed 2,500 lbs.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject if pallet is not display-ready when required.

load_pattern.special: Use LMF-specific slip sheets (brown kraft). No substitutes.

sop_rules.receiving: Verify all lot numbers match purchase order.
sop_rules.shipping: Products must be sorted by aisle planogram order.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject if lot number does not match PO.
sop_rules.temp_check: Reefer unit must show continuous temp log for transit.

load_pattern.special: Canned goods: labels facing same direction for shelf-ready display.

sop_rules.receiving: Inspect for pest evidence on all produce pallets.
sop_rules.shipping: Allergen products must be on separate pallets from non-allergen.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject produce with any visible mold or pest damage.
sop_rules.temp_check: Produce: pulp temperature required, not air temperature.

load_pattern.special: Organic certification docs must accompany every organic pallet.

sop_rules.receiving: Verify organic certification on all organic products.
sop_rules.shipping: Non-GMO and organic must be segregated from conventional.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject if organic certification is missing or expired.

load_pattern.special: Use Harborway Markets-branded pallet tags for all outbound shipments.

sop_rules.receiving: Check for recalled product against active recall list.
sop_rules.shipping: Load nose-to-tail: heaviest pallets at nose of trailer.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject any product on active recall list immediately.

load_pattern.special: Pallets must be GMA standard (48x40). No oversized pallets.

sop_rules.receiving: Verify vendor code matches approved vendor list.
sop_rules.shipping: Maximum 22 pallets per 53-foot trailer.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject non-GMA pallets. Request re-palletization.
sop_rules.temp_check: Ridgeview Grocery follows Harborway Markets standards.

load_pattern.special: Display-ready packaging preferred. Minimize waste packaging.

sop_rules.receiving: Standard receiving procedures apply.
sop_rules.shipping: Cost-efficient loading: maximize cube utilization.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Standard rejection criteria apply.

load_pattern.special: Private label products must be handled separately from vendor brands.

sop_rules.receiving: Verify all items are Captain's Pantry private label.
sop_rules.shipping: Artwork/packaging must be undamaged for shelf display.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject if packaging artwork is damaged (brand image).

load_pattern.special: Standard Midwest distribution palletization rules.

sop_rules.receiving: Standard receiving procedures.
sop_rules.shipping: Weather protection required for paper goods in winter.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Standard criteria apply.

load_pattern.special: Bulk items can be floor-stacked if pallet is unavailable.

sop_rules.receiving: Standard procedures. Valufresh accepts minor cosmetic damage.
sop_rules.shipping: Maximize pallet count per trailer.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Only reject for safety/quality issues, not cosmetic.

load_pattern.special: Use Piedmont Foods delivery window scheduling. No early arrivals.

sop_rules.receiving: Must arrive within scheduled delivery window.
sop_rules.shipping: Delivery appointment required. No unscheduled deliveries.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: May reject if outside delivery window.

load_pattern.special: Premium presentation required. No damaged outer packaging.

sop_rules.receiving: Higher quality standards than typical Tier 3.
sop_rules.shipping: All cases must have clean, undamaged outer packaging.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject if outer packaging is torn, stained, or crushed.

load_pattern.special: Club-size packaging. Verify multi-pack counts.

sop_rules.receiving: Verify inner pack count on multi-packs.
sop_rules.shipping: Similar to Bulkhaven Club/Keystone Club palletization standards.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject if multi-pack is opened or count is wrong.

load_pattern.special: Foodservice packaging. Cases must withstand restaurant handling.

sop_rules.receiving: Verify HACCP documentation accompanies all shipments.
sop_rules.shipping: Segregate by temperature zone within trailer if mixed load.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Reject without HACCP documentation.

load_pattern.special: Route-optimized loading: first stop loaded last (nose of trailer).

sop_rules.receiving: Standard foodservice receiving procedures.
sop_rules.shipping: Load in reverse delivery order for multi-stop routes.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Standard criteria. Strict on allergen segregation.

load_pattern.special: Convenience store distribution. Mixed category pallets OK.

sop_rules.receiving: Standard procedures. High volume, fast turnaround expected.
sop_rules.shipping: Mixed category pallets acceptable for convenience store orders.
sop_rules.rejection_criteria: Standard criteria apply.
